decisions.reason: The accelerator program is shown on the home page and supports the firm's publicly announced circular-economy mission, so the visible commitment favors keeping it even though it sits furthest from the core machinery business.
The bio-based bitumen binder has its own page and fits the CO2-negative circularity narrative, so management will likely blame weak early uptake on market immaturity and persist.
The infectious waste decontamination plant is close to the firm's modular treatment expertise, rests on substantial engineering investment and is featured on the home page, so it is retained.
The mobile mechanical recycling plant embodies the firm's decentralized recycling strategy and is prominently promoted, making it central to the firm's announced direction.
